name: x402
summary: An HTTP-native payment standard: a server answers 402 Payment Required with its price, the client pays (mostly in stablecoins) and retries with proof of payment. Built for agents paying per request for APIs and content, now governed by the x402 Foundation under the Linux Foundation.
facts: EVM chains, Solana and others; chain-agnostic
goodFor: Pay-per-call APIs without accounts or API keys
watchOut: Reported on-chain volume includes self-dealing (per third-party analysis)
